lead.zh: 按搭建顺序读接口、检索、工具调用、评测与成本。阅读用于理解链路；实际接入还需按当前版本检查并验证。
lead.en: Study interfaces, retrieval, tools, evaluation and cost in build order. This explains the pipeline; actual integration still needs version checks and validation.

zh: 说清一次 API 调用的费用由哪几段 token 构成
解释检索链路里分块与嵌入各自决定什么
指出接入工具调用时最先要设的两道防线
en: Break down an API call's cost into its token segments
Explain what chunking and embedding each determine in a retrieval pipeline
Name the first two defenses to put in place when adding tool calling

answers.zh: 输入包括指令、历史、检索材料和工具返回；输出是模型生成的内容。按各自用量乘相应单价，再核对缓存、工具与重试是否另计，不用一个总 Token 数乘同一单价。
answers.en: Input includes instructions, history, retrieved material and tool results; output is generated content. Apply the relevant rates and check cache, tool and retry charges separately. Do not assume one rate for every token.

answers.zh: 分块决定一次取回的信息单元；嵌入决定文本的向量表示。先查答案所在块是否进入候选，再检查排序与生成，避免把检索问题误当成生成问题。
answers.en: Chunking defines retrieval units; embedding represents text as vectors. Check whether the answer-bearing chunk reaches candidates before investigating ranking and generation.

answers.zh: 执行端校验工具名称、参数与授权范围；把检索内容和工具结果作为不可信数据处理。涉及写入或外部影响的动作，按业务风险设置审批与可撤回方式。
answers.en: Validate tool names, arguments and authorization at execution. Treat retrieved text and tool results as untrusted data. Add approval and recovery according to the risk of writes or external effects.
